subject: Week 4: Mastering Barre Chords 🎸
body: Hey there! This week we're tackling the F major barre chord. I know it's tough, but with the exercises in this lesson, you'll nail it. Remember: practice 15 minutes daily beats 2 hours once a week!

subject: Re: Week 4: Mastering Barre Chords 🎸
body: Hi Justin! I've been practicing but my index finger keeps muting the high E string. Any tips for proper finger placement? Thanks!

subject: Re: Week 4: Mastering Barre Chords 🎸
body: Hey! That's super common. Try rolling your index finger slightly so the harder edge (near the thumb side) is pressing the strings instead of the flat pad. Also make sure you're close to the fret. Keep at it! 🎸

subject: Review your new Boss Katana 100 MkII

body: Hey Mike! The Katana sounds incredible. I'm blown away by the Brown channel - getting amazing classic rock tones. Quick question: is there a way to connect to the Tone Studio app via Bluetooth or is USB the only option?
